evidence.description: The event enum contains only an empty-string case.
The empty raw value is passed directly to the SDK.

candidates.explanation: The only event exposed by CustomEvent has an empty raw value, and logCustomEvent forwards that value directly to Braze as the event name. Consequently, every event expressible through this API has an empty name rather than a meaningful analytics identifier.
candidates.title: Custom event API only produces empty event names

evidence.description: Every enabled initialize call invokes SDK initialization and starts a new task without retaining or checking initialization state.
SDK initialization unconditionally replaces the stored instance and recreates the in-app message presenter.

candidates.explanation: Initialization has no already-initialized or in-progress check. Each enabled call replaces the stored Braze instance, rebuilds its UI integration, and launches another untracked notification-registration and consent task. Repeated calls can therefore duplicate setup and overlap asynchronous initialization work within the singleton.
candidates.title: Repeated initialization recreates the SDK and duplicates asynchronous work
